text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Daiwa Scarlet and I drop by the shopping district on our way back from a day out.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: What's with the crowd?

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Step right up and try your luck with our New Year's raffle! This year's grand-prize is a coupon for a hot spring vacation for two!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot hamburger steak! Second-prize winners get a bushel of carrots! And third-prize winners can take home a single carrot!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Don't let this opportunity pass you by! Get a ticket now and spin for your chance to win!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ahhh, so today's the raffle. I'd better put this to use!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: This raffle ticket. A friend gave it to me.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: She said it was thanks for helping her with her homework. Hmph! Like I wouldn't have done it anyway.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: But, well… seeing as I have the ticket, I might as well cash it in. Let's give it a spin.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We get in line, and I watch as Daiwa Scarlet spins the lever on the raffle machine.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A small plastic ball drops from the tumbler's opening…

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves a grand-prize winner! Come and get the coupon for your hot spring vacation! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Whoa! The grand-prize?! Did I really win?! I-I mean, yay!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hmph! I knew I could do it. When it comes to luck, I'm always number one!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hmm… When should we go? The expiration date is quite a while off.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I guess I should just keep it safe for now.
choice_data_list: You're not going to use it right away?
You're not going to use it right away?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I don't think so. I mean, we're in the middle of a very important series. Neither of us have time to take a break just yet.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I want to make the most of this chance to relax… and I want you to make the most of it too.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Are you being serious? …Dummy.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Oh, forget it! At any rate, now's not the time!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: So, you keep it for now. I don't think I can trust myself with it.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: But you'd better not use it on yourself! It's my prize, got that?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At Daiwa Scarlet's insistence, I end up holding on to the coupon until the time comes to use it.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Looks like we have another first-prize winner! Congratulations! You get one deluxe carrot hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hehe, not bad! I'll never turn down being first! ♪

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Oh? Are you hungry or something?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Then, here. You can have it. I've got food at the dorm anyway.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Would you get a clue already?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: This is where you're supposed to nod and say thank you.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I'm not a bad cook, you know. I could whip something like this up for you anytime—if you wanted.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: …So ask me. I don't mind doing something nice for you once in a while.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I appreciate the sentiment, but it's her prize, and it does look really good. I'd like her to try it too…
choice_data_list: How about we eat it together?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hmph. That's fine too, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Both Daiwa Scarlet and I feast on carrot hamburger steak that day.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: We got a second-prize winner! It's your lucky day! You're going home with a bushel of carrots!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I got… second place?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: No way! I don't want second place, race or not! Just the thought of the number two makes me sick!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer! Are you sure you don't have a ticket?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: You don't sound sure. Turn out your pockets. I bet you've got one somewhere!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It takes a full body check for Daiwa Scarlet to release me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Still, it isn't the carrots' fault they were the second-prize.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'll have to think of a way to incorporate them into Daiwa Scarlet's nutrition plan…

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Would you lookie here! You've won the third-prize! Here's your carrot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Well, so much for that. At least I won something.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: But still, a single carrot, huh… I wonder what I should make with it…
choice_data_list: You're going to cook with it?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I'd like to make something for the friend who gave me the ticket.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I'm a model student, after all. I have to repay her kindness.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hmm, maybe a carrot cake? That sounds good. Everyone likes sweet things.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Daiwa Scarlet and I pick up some groceries on the way back to the dorm.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, tough luck! Looks like you pulled a blank one! Take this pack of tissues as a consolation prize.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Aww… I guess I should have expected that. That's normal, after all. But still…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Just coming out and saying "tough luck" like that really ticks me off!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wary of letting Daiwa Scarlet's anger explode in public, I decide to accompany her back to school.
